questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All tigers are fishes.

No elephant is a tiger.

Some deer are tigers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some fishes are deer.

II. No elephant is a deer.

III. No deer is a fish.

options.text: Only conclusion I and II follow.
Only conclusion I and III follow.

questions.solution:
From the given statements we draw a Venn diagram:

All tigers are fishes.

No elephant is a tiger.

Some deer are tigers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4603786ed83bf898f505ce28f4cf734cc00758e5775d99f87d026b3505642ed2.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some fishes are deer **→ Follow →** As some tigers are deer and all tigers are fishes so it is safe to say that some fishes are deer and therefore the conclusion follows.

II. No elephant is a deer **→ Does not follow → **As no elephant is a tiger so there is a possibility that elephants are related deer and fishes, which makes this conclusion wrong and thus the conclusion does not follow.

III. No deer is a fish → Does not follow → As some deer are tigers and we know that all tiger are fishes which means there is a direct relation which leads us to the conclusion that some deer are fishes and thus the conclusion does not follow.

Since **only conclusion I follows.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement :**

All Bananas are Grapes.

All Papayas are Pineapple.

Some Pineapples are Banana.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Papayas are Grapes.

(II) Some Grapes are Pineapples.

(III) Some Bananas are Papayas.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and III follow
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
From the given statements, we draw a Venn diagram:

All Bananas are Grapes.

All Papayas are Pineapple.

Some Pineapples are Banana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e59c39d3122ac7b2ca2718c604559bcf9dce3057fbdc4ac610c572cd2a7366ef.png] 

**Conclusion:**

(I) Some Papayas are Grapes **→ Does not follow → **As there is no relation given between papayas and grapes and from the diagram we can see that papayas does not share any region with grapes and thus the conclusion does not follow.

(II) Some Grapes are Pineapples **→ Follow → **As all bananas are grapes and some pineapples are bananas so it can be also said that some grapes are pineapples and therefore the conclusion follows.

(III) Some Bananas are Papayas **→ Does not follow → **As some bananas are pineapples and all papayas are pineapples but it will be wrong to assume that some bananas are papayas because there is no proof of relation between them and thus the conclusion does not follow.

Since **only conclusion II follows.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
